record.edic_text:
1550 ekdapanao {ek-dap-an-ah'-o}

from 1537 and 1159;; v

AV - spend 1; 1

1) to exhaust by expending, to spend wholly, use up,
2) to spend one's self wholly

same.cexp: 免費的，不需花錢的（#林前 9:18|）
